esp32.detail: 6 pins wired; Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 4.7 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x68. Added the icm42688.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the acceleration, rotation and temperature set on the sliders: passes
